crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An irregular, approximately triangular rufous patch is clearly visible on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: The boundary is distinct, characterized by the contrast between the grey crown/mantle and the intervening rufous nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent horizontal black and white barring on the elongated tail feathers and a small red mark on the crown.
